title: Medication dose and instructions
transcript: Patient: My home blood pressure has been around 150 over 90 for the past two weeks. No dizziness.
Clinician: Today your blood pressure is 152/92. I assessed this as uncontrolled high blood pressure.
Clinician: Start amlodipine 5 mg by mouth once daily. Check your blood pressure at home and come back in two weeks. Call us if you feel dizzy after starting it.

title: Two different agreed orders
transcript: Patient: I have had heavy periods for three months and feel tired. I am not fainting.
Clinician: Your pulse is 88. The cause of the fatigue is uncertain. Low iron is one possibility.
Clinician: I am ordering a complete blood count today. I am placing a referral to gynecology for the heavy bleeding. Call us if bleeding gets heavier.

title: Discussed treatment does not become an order
transcript: Patient: I have had a sore throat for two days. No trouble breathing.
Clinician: Your temperature is 98.4 Fahrenheit. Your throat is mildly red.

Clinician: This may be a viral sore throat. We discussed amoxicillin if a future test confirms strep. We are holding off on testing and antibiotics today. Drink fluids and call us if you are not getting better in three days.

soap_note.subjective: Sore throat for two days. Denies difficulty breathing.

fixture.visit_summary_for_patient: A virus may be causing your sore throat. Drink fluids. We are holding off on tests and antibiotics today. Call us if you are not getting better in three days.

title: Filter chatter and retain barriers to care
transcript: Patient: The baseball game was fun. I have missed two weeks of physical therapy because the bus route was cut and I cannot afford a ride. My knee still hurts on stairs.
Clinician: Your right knee bends to 110 degrees. This is ongoing right knee pain.
Clinician: We will have the clinic call you tomorrow to discuss transportation options for your existing physical therapy visits. Come back in four weeks.

title: Use the corrected laterality and preserve symptom denial
transcript: Patient: My left ankle hurts. Sorry, I meant my right ankle. I twisted it yesterday. I have no numbness.
Clinician: Right ankle swelling is mild. Right ankle sprain is my working diagnosis.
Clinician: Rest the ankle and keep it raised. Come back in one week. Call us sooner if you cannot put weight on it. No tests today.
